turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma? It's me, Danny. I'm in trouble and I don't know who else to call.

turns.speaker: subscriber
turns.text: Danny? Oh my goodness, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I hit another car and the police are holding me. The lawyer says I can go home today if we sort it out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Could you go to the bank, take out whatever you can spare, and hand it to the man he sends to your house? Please don't tell Mom.

turns.speaker: subscriber
turns.text: Oh, sweetheart. Okay, let me find my purse.
